tei:div.tei:p: Blessed art thou, Lord our God, King of the universe, Creator of all the worlds, righteous in all generations, faithful God, who sayest and performest, who speakest and fulfillest, for all thy words are true and just.

Faithful art thou, Lord our God, and faithful are thy words; no word of thine returns unfulfilled, for thou art a faithful and merciful God and King. Blessed art thou, O Lord God, who art faithful in all thy words.
Have compassion on Zion, for it is the source of our life; save the humbled soul speedily in our days. Blessed art thou, O Lord, who makest Zion rejoice in her children.

Gladden us, Lord our God, with the appearance of thy servant Elijah the prophet, and with the rule of the house of David thy anointed. May he soon come and bring joy to our heart. Let no stranger occupy David’s throne; let others no longer possess themselves of his glory, for thou didst promise him by thy holy name that his light would never go out. Blessed art thou, O Lord, Shield of David.
